name: Kart Racing Game VR
summary:
Step into the driver's seat and experience the excitement of kart racing like never before in virtual reality!

Kart Racing Game VR delivers fast-paced racing action with immersive VR gameplay, colorful tracks, and thrilling competition. Navigate challenging courses, master sharp turns, collect speed boosts, and outpace your rivals as you race toward the finish line.
